sections.title: Schur-Weyl representations
sections.extract: []{#sect:schur-weyl label="sect:schur-weyl"} In this section, we use the same tools to study other measures on partitions and to describe asymptotically the shape of the diagrams. The purpose of this section is to show that our method works as soon as the typical length of the first rows of the diagram is of order $n^\alpha$ with $\alpha>1/2$ and not only with $\alpha=1$.
